judgements.justification: A's AC broke the visible 8/5/5 split by citing an emergency reviewer, whose input is not on the forum, and rejected 'Based on this input'.

A (xzpB, AC) counted the lack of theory and of an analysis of why FCP works against an empirical method paper, while B's sJ2R discounted theory because none applies and B valued the human results on their own terms.
The below-threshold scores held after rebuttal (tdpf, xzpB in A; bYPA in B) rested on novelty, generality and theory, which are central to the contribution, not peripheral points.
